text: Let A be an array of n distinct numbers sorted in increasing order. Binary search is a technique the searches for a particular number £ by comparing k to the item in the middle of A and then either recursing to the left subarray or the right subarray. Let BSearch(A, s, f,k) be the binary search procedure, which returns true if element k is contained in the array A between indices s and f. Write the pseudo-code for BSearch(A, s, f,k). Explain why the worst-case runtime has recurrence 7'(n) = T'(n/2) + ¢. Show that T'(n) is Ologn) using the substitution method.
